name: 37228 · Nashville, TN
findings: ZIP 37228 (Nashville) has 64 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (48% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37228 (Nashville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 37228 (Nashville) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 14.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 19% of all organizations here have no identified type.
